decisive_items: CD4 to CD8 cells ratio within hair follicles > 7:1
monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement was demonstrated
response.rationale: The presence of atypical lymphocytes, abnormal CD4 to CD8 ratio, and monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement supports the diagnosis of Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, which is more specific than Mycosis Fungoides.

rejected.why: Lack of specific support for Folliculotropic Mycosis Fungoides beyond perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates.
